notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding two mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Ilysian Caryatid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Ilysian Caryatid.
Repeat.
